data.gender_notes: Intizar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is waiting, anticipating, or expecting. The name Intizar carries the meaning “To Expect, To Wait” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Intizar usually hope their child will grow to embody to expect, to wait and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Intizar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To Expect, To Wait.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Intizar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إنطزار
in_arabic.long_meaning: إنطزار يأتي من الجذر النطزَرَ وَهُوَ يُشير إلى الانتظار والمطالبة بالصالح وتحقيق الأمانة. في الأصل، كان هذا الاسم يُستخدم لوصف الشخص الذي ينتظر بكل سرور وقبول الأوامر السماوية ويكون طاعةً لله تعالى. يُعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء القديمة التي تمتلك تاريخًا غنيًا في الإسلام، حيث كان يُستخدم لوصف الصالحين والذين ينتظرون بكل صبر وحرص ما يأتي من الله تعالى. في الوقت الحاضر، يُستخدم هذا الاسم لوصف الأطفال الذكور الذين يُعتبرون صغارًا لكنهم يتمتعون بمزايا خاصة تُشير إلى مستقبلهم اللامع.

in_urdu.name: انٹظر
in_urdu.meaning: منتظر کے لیے اننتظار اور ایماندار کیوں
in_urdu.long_meaning: انٹظر نام کا تعلق بھی Arabic جذر ہے. اس نام سے مراد ہے کہ وہ شخص جو اللہ کی ہدایت پر عمل کرے اور صبر و شکیبہی سے انتظار کرتا ہے. یہ نام بھی ایماندار کے لیے ہے، جو اللہ کے احکام پر عمل کرے اور آخرت کا انتظار کرتا ہے. اس نام کی تاریخ بھی اسلامی روایات سے جڑی ہوئی ہے اور یہ نام اسی نام سے ملتا ہے جو عرب میں پرانا روایتی نام تھا.

in_hindi.name: इन्तिज़ार
in_hindi.meaning: अंतिम समय की प्रतीक्षा करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: इन्तिज़ार नाम का अर्थ है अंतिम समय की प्रतीक्षा करने वाला। यह नाम अरबी जड़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है इंतजार और विश्वास। इस नाम का उपयोग अक्सर उन लोगों के लिए किया जाता है जो ईश्वर के नियमों का पालन करते हैं और अंतिम समय की प्रतीक्षा करते हैं। इन्तिज़ार नाम का इतिहास मुस्लिम परंपराओं से जुड़ा हुआ है और यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है।

in_english.name: Intizar
in_english.meaning: Awaiting the righteous and fulfilling one's trust
in_english.long_meaning: The name Intizar is derived from the Arabic root n-t-z-r, which means awaiting and fulfilling one's trust. In its original context, the name refers to a person who awaits with patience and acceptance the divine orders and is obedient to Allah. The name has a rich history in Islamic tradition and is associated with the righteous and those who await with hope and anticipation the rewards from Allah. In modern times, the name Intizar is used to signify a child who is born with a promise of a bright future and is expected to grow up into a righteous and trustworthy individual.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the concept of "Intizar" is deeply connected to the idea of patience, perseverance, and submission to Allah's will. This can be observed in various aspects of Islamic life, such as during times of hardship, adversity, or suffering. Intizar also reflects the belief in the Day of Judgment and the reward or punishment that comes after death. Muslims are encouraged to practice Intizar in their daily lives, reminding them to keep their faith strong in times of uncertainty and to remain steadfast in their belief in Allah's divine plan.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Intizar" holds great significance in Islamic teachings. It reflects the belief that Faith and patience are essential virtues, which enable individuals to withstand life's trials and tribulations with dignity and serenity. The name also underscores the importance of trusting in Allah's plan and understanding that He is in ultimate control of one's destiny. Ultimately, Intizar is a reminder that the true reward for a believer lies in the hereafter, and that true happiness and contentment come from living in accordance with Allah's will.
